fields.name: Additional information IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for Additional information

fields.name: Additional information length
fields.description: Length of the Additional information field

fields.name: Additional information value
fields.description: The coding of the additional information value is dependent on the generic message container type

notes: The Additional information is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets
The purpose of the Additional information information element is to provide additional information to upper layers in relation to the generic NAS message transport mechanism
